items.title: 4.3 Combining Computational Structures for Complex Problems (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of combining structures (PDF 118).

blocks.text: Complex (pecheeda) problems (masle) achhi tarah hal karne ke liye alag alag data structures, jaise lists, stacks, queues, trees aur graphs, ko mila kar istemal karna zaroori hai. Har structure ki apni khoobiyan hain, aur mila kar hum mushkil problems zyada kamyabi se hal kar sakte hain.

In ko milane se zyada mazboot aur efficient hal bante hain. Yeh data ke complex rishte sambhalne aur problems hal karne ki ability (salahiyat) barhane mein madad deta hai. In structures ko saath istemal kar ke hum aise hal bana sakte hain jo khaas zaroorat ke mutabiq hon, aur program ki performance (raftaar) aur functionality (program kya kya kar sakta hai) dono behtar hon.

blocks.prompt: Mez (desk) ko organize karne (tarteeb se rakhne) ka kaam sochiye. Stack aur queue dono kaise madad kar sakte hain (long question 8)?
blocks.explanation: Kaam (kaghaz tarteeb dena, kitabein rakhna, mez saaf karna) queue mein rakhein taake plan ke order se hon. Kaghaz stack ki tarah jama hote hain: sab se oopar, yaani aakhir mein rakha kaghaz, pehle utha kar file hota hai; kitabein bhi dher bana kar oopar se rakhi jati hain. Queue kaamon ka order tay karti hai; stack har kaam ke andar ki cheezein sambhalta hai.

items: Structures mila kar har ek ki khoobi complex problems mein kaam aati hai.
